newsitem.title: USA: Dayton to sell stores to Dillard, Penney.
newsitem.headline: Dayton to sell stores to Dillard, Penney.

text.p: Dayton Hudson Corp said Friday that Dillard Department Stores Inc has agreed to buy 10 of its 18 Mervyn's Florida locations, while J.C. Penney Co Inc has agreed to purchase three of seven Mervyn's Georgia locations.
Dayton said it is negotiating or has entered into a series of agreements to sell Mervyn's 25 stores in Florida and Georgia.
Earlier today, Dayton said its Mervyn's division will exit the Florida and George markets.
The remaining properties are expected to be sold to a variety of other purchasers.
It is expected that many of the 2,100 affected Mervyn's employees in Florida and Georgia will receive job offers from Dayton's Target Stores.
Dayton said the Mervyn's stores it will close throughout the chain are poor-performing units. The stores will be sold or will close in the next 12 to 18 months.
The majority of affected employees are expected to be offered positions at other Mervyn's stores in those markets.
Dayton operates 1,101 stores in 38 states. This includes 736 Target stores, 300 Mervyn's stores and 65 department stores.
